_comment: Specification only. NOT deployed to any Retell account and NOT verified against a live agent. Field names for the agent and post-call analysis must be checked against Retell's current API before use.
purpose: Confirm a plumbing service appointment by phone for the fictional company 'Nimbus Plumbing'.
prompt_rules: Identify the company and purpose in the first sentence. Never read out payment or card details.
If the person is not the customer, say you will call back and end the call: outcome wrong_number or no_answer, never confirmed.
Only report confirmed or declined when the customer says so clearly; otherwise report unclear with a low confidence.
If asked to change the time, do not promise anything: report reschedule.
If the person asks not to be called again, say it will be noted and report refused.

post_call_analysis_schema.outcome: enum: confirmed, declined, reschedule, no_answer, voicemail, wrong_number, refused, dropped, unclear
post_call_analysis_schema.confidence: number between 0 and 1: how clearly the customer stated it

webhook: POST to the receiver; verify X-Retell-Signature on the raw body; handle call_ended and call_analyzed only
